styleAuthority: Original slapstick sports caricature, touchline-ink-1 ink language; absurd silhouette and prop proportions.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production background for an OUTRAGEOUS 2D FOOTBALL COMEDY GAME, landscape 16:10. Create an ORIGINAL slapstick clubhouse hub with the grotesque sports-caricature energy of Tape to Tape. The supplied contact sheet is our actual player art: keep its dark ink contours and flat cel color language, but exaggerate the ENVIRONMENT MUCH more. Do NOT put the portrait sheet or people into the image.
This is a fearless CARTOON, not a plausible sports facility. Every building should be visibly SQUASHED, STRETCHED, BOWED and ASYMMETRICAL. Use swollen bulbous shapes against ridiculously skinny supports, strong slants, enormous props 3 times their sensible size, jaunty impossible perspective. Dominant outer ink line 7-10px at 1600px width; loose expressive inner lines, 2-tone cel shadows, strong flat teal, mustard, rusty coral and violet accents. Broad clean shapes, readable silhouettes.
Compose a cohesive club yard with these DISTINCT hilarious landmarks and paths between them:
UPPER LEFT: tiny training field littered with 3 outrageously HUGE leaning orange cones, one a stack of cones wearing a single boot, a goal with sagging elastic crossbar.
UPPER RIGHT: a stadium grandstand sagging like a hammock, held by bent matchstick pillars; its oversized football-shaped entrance has a toothy arch, one floodlight tower bent like an exhausted neck.
MID LEFT: absurd leaning changing-room hut shaped like a squat football boot, its roof a floppy red cap, gigantic open double doors with a single oversized green shirt visible; a huge brass WHISTLE is its chimney.
CENTER: tactics shelter held up by one leaning crutch-like pole, giant bowed green chalkboard at front, simple football field/circles, and bench shaped like an exhausted banana. No writing.
MID RIGHT: a tiny accountant's office almost swallowed by a gigantic cartoon calculator and ludicrous overflowing paper ledger; bulging window, roof bent under a stack of blank files.
LOWER LEFT: scouting minivan with tiny body, two absurdly HUGE mismatched wheels, stretched snout/bonnet, crooked headlights and roof luggage taller than the van, a giant paper map flapping like a tongue. Funny personality through geometry, no real eyes.
LOWER CENTER: squat newspaper kiosk with a saggy striped awning, enormous loosely stacked blank papers, an oversize CRT with rabbit ears resembling referee flags, a chunky knob as big as a football, dark blank screen.
Beside kiosk a purple VHS archive crate that seems overstuffed, tapes at crazy angles.
LOWER RIGHT: a leaning trophy cupboard with a ridiculously ENORMOUS golden football boot crushing the top, one tiny trophy on lower shelf. Exaggerated original trophies, no copied characters/logos.
Ground is a few broad mint/ochre shapes and winding path; trees are 4 or 5 lumped wobbly shapes. Fill the image. Fun like a chaotic underdog football club held together by tape, rather than a tidy village.
NO people, words, labels, logos, UI panels or numbers. NO realistic architecture, straight conservative rectangular buildings, evenly balanced symmetric objects, tiny realistic details, rustic postcard scenery, gradients, lifelike texture, realistic lighting, 3D or painterly rendering. The comedy must be IMMEDIATELY obvious even when viewed as a thumbnail. Push shape exaggeration to 10 out of 10.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original production environment for an OUTRAGEOUS cartoon football management game. Landscape 16:10. INPUT 1 is our player's flat-ink portrait sheet and INPUT 2 is our new absurd clubhouse yard: match its punchy dark ink, wild squash-and-stretch architecture and slapstick scale, with the irreverent sports comedy energy of Tape to Tape. Original artwork, no existing characters. Bold 7-10px outer contours, lively thin internal linework, flat cel color, mustard, coral, teal and small violet accents. Every prop has a funny silhouette, aggressively lopsided, stretched or squashed. No plausible conservative room design. NO realistic lighting or materials, gradients, 3D, painterly detail or precious rustic scenery. NO humans, portraits, letters, numerals, logos or interface panels.
A surreal football team's changing room, straight-on shallow perspective, as if built inside the enormous football-boot-shaped clubhouse. The middle 80% of the scene from y25% to y76% MUST be a clean uninterrupted mostly empty deep teal wall; only 4 or 5 giant warped wall panels, so real interactive lockers and player portraits will be placed on top. Do NOT draw lockers in this reserved region.
The upper 22% is hilarious: the ceiling droops like an exhausted hammock, a giant brass whistle-shaped ventilation pipe sticks in at upper left, two comically pinched tiny skewed windows, a football-shaped clock swollen 3 times normal size leaning at upper right with blank face and two hands, fat bent water pipes that tie themselves in a loose knot at the far right edge. A ginormous rolled sock hangs limply off the far right pipe. Far left edge a crooked door with enormous coach clipboard and absurdly tiny pencil, visible at edge only.
Along the BOTTOM 18% an exaggerated bowed yellow wooden bench sags under the weight of ONE gigantic battered football boot at far left. Its shoelace is tangled in a football. Far right a tiny shower door almost covered by a ludicrously long striped towel that puddles on the floor. Floor tiles are oversized wobbly terracotta trapezoids. Simple central wall to keep roster readable, comedy concentrated at ceiling, far sides and bottom. Exaggeration 10/10, very chunky graphic silhouettes, bold lively line. No text and no people.
